result.question: Compare R&D spending as a share of revenue across Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years.
result.answer:
R&D spending as a share of revenue varies notably across Tesla, Apple, and Nvidia in their most recent fiscal years. Tesla reported R&D expense of $6,411 million against total revenue of $94,827 million in FY 2025 (fiscal year ending December 31, 2025), yielding an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 6.8% [0001628280-26-003952:item-8-p007] [0001628280-26-003952:item-7-p017]. Apple reported R&D expense of $34,550 million against net sales of $416,161 million in FY 2025 (fiscal year ending September 27, 2025), yielding an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 8.3% [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2025-09-27] [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2025-09-27]. Nvidia reported R&D expense of $18,497 million against total revenue of $215,938 million in FY 2026 (fiscal year ending January 25, 2026), yielding an R&D-to-revenue ratio of approximately 8.6% [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense:2026-01-25] [xbrl:0001045810-26-000021:us-gaap:Revenues:2026-01-25] [0001045810-26-000021:item-7-p007].
